description: Source code for an MD5 hashing driver for the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) module in the Linux kernel, specifically for the Infineon Technologies' UEIP project. Implements MD5 hashing functions interfacing with hardware.

methods.name: md5_transform
methods.description: Main interface to MD5 hardware, processes a 64-byte input block and updates hash state.

methods.name: md5_transform_helper
methods.description: Helper function to call md5_transform with current context.

methods.name: md5_update
methods.description: Processes input data on-the-fly, updating the hash context.

methods.name: md5_final
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 hash computation and outputs the digest.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5
methods.description: Registers the MD5 driver with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5
methods.description: Unregisters the MD5 driver from the Linux crypto API.
